signals.title: movie-gen: open MIT pipeline for 5-12 min AI films (Seedance 2.0 + Higgsfield CLI, driven by Claude Code)
signals.summary: Open-source (MIT) pipeline chains Seedance 2.0 video, Nano Banana Pro images, Sonilo music, ElevenLabs voice, Gemini QC through Higgsfield's CLI and ffmpeg. Built to be orchestrated by Claude Code. ~10 finished films, one is 11 min / 80 shots with consistent characters.
signals.run_with_it_note: Clone it, point Claude Code at it, feed one real DCKT or NKST shot list plus actual tour footage as reference, generate one 2-3 min branded film this week. His Seedance/Higgsfield stack already exists; the new part is multi-shot consistency orchestrated by an agent.

signals.title: Kimi-K3 open weights land on HuggingFace (2.8T params, Apache 2.0, Fable-competitive)
signals.summary: Moonshot published full weights today for the first ~3T-parameter open-weight frontier model, MXFP4 quantized, under Apache 2.0. Benchmarks near Fable 5 on agentic/coding. Front page of HN (540 pts), corroborated by Fireworks and Artificial Analysis.
signals.run_with_it_note: Swap it in as the brain behind an existing SMS/voice loop on his Twilio line via any open-weight host (Fireworks, Together). Frontier quality with no single-vendor lock or price-hike risk. Cost of a test run is pennies.

signals.title: OpenWorker: MIT desktop AI agent that ships finished work, runs local (Andrew Ng)
signals.summary: Open-source (MIT) desktop agent produces real documents, spreadsheets, calendar updates across 25+ integrations (Gmail, Notion, Slack, Jira), runs on your machine with BYO key or fully local via Ollama, supports scheduled automations with approval gates. Open beta.
signals.run_with_it_note: Install from source, wire one business's Gmail + Notion, set a scheduled morning task (draft replies, update a booking sheet). Data stays on his box. Proves an owned ops-agent for the 12-business back office.

signals.title: FLUX 3: Black Forest Labs omni model, 20-sec video with native audio from one prompt
signals.summary: Single architecture jointly generates image, video, audio, and actions. Up to 20-sec clips with dialogue/SFX/music, keyframe control, multi-shot chaining. But only Video + Action are live via gated early access to selected partners; open-weight FLUX 3 Dev is planned later in 2026.
signals.run_with_it_note: Gated partner access only right now, so not yet ownable. Get on the waitlist and watch for FLUX 3 Dev open weights; when it drops it becomes a direct content-engine Spark alongside movie-gen.

signals.title: Claude Voice Mode adds Gmail, Slack, Notion, Calendar across Opus/Sonnet/Haiku
signals.summary: Anthropic expanded voice to act on Gmail, Slack, Notion, and Google Calendar by voice across all three model tiers. Closes the desk-to-mobile gap but rides Anthropic's platform.
signals.run_with_it_note: Usable today for his own inbox/calendar by voice, but it is rented land (Anthropic can change it). Fine as a personal driver; do not build a business on it. The owned version is grok-voice on his Twilio line.

signals.title: Microsoft MAI-Voice-2-Flash: cheap voice model in public preview
signals.summary: Microsoft debuted a cost-effective voice model (MAI-Voice-2-Flash) plus MAI-Image-2.5-Pro in public preview. Another cheap voice option for agent lines, on Microsoft's platform.

signals.title: Runway Media Router: auto-picks best image/video/audio model per job
signals.summary: Developer infra that routes each generation to the optimal media model by quality/speed/cost. Useful plumbing for a content engine but rides Runway.

signals.title: Cognition acquires Poke, a personal Apple Messages agent
signals.summary: Cognition (Devin) bought The Interaction Company and its Poke iMessage agent. A tell that personal desk-to-mobile agents are consolidating into bigger platforms.

signals.title: USV: Obliterate, Don't Automate (build to replace gatekeepers, not workflows)
signals.summary: Union Square Ventures thesis: the AI winners restructure a market by removing the gatekeeper, not by automating the existing steps. Framing fuel, not a tool.

signals.title: CheapSecurity: lightweight self-hosted CCTV for Linux SBCs
signals.summary: Open-source, self-hosted camera stack for cheap single-board computers. Ownable and durable, but adjacent to David's watch domains rather than inside them.

signals.title: xAI Grok Voice Agent Builder (no-code phone agents)
signals.summary: No-code builder deploys a production phone agent in ~2 min, sub-second latency, SIP into existing numbers, ~$0.06/min. Still the standing owned-line voice play; carried from last run.
signals.run_with_it_note: Point it at a spare Twilio DID, feed one business FAQ doc, let it answer the after-hours booking line for NPB or DCKT. Carried from 2026-07-26; still the best desk-to-mobile move he owns.

signals.title: Cactus Hybrid: on-device model that knows when it's wrong
signals.summary: Open-source confidence probes keep 45-85% of queries on a small local model, escalating only hard ones to cloud. Carried from last run; still a strong own-the-ground edge play.
signals.run_with_it_note: Run it on a phone/edge box against a real DCKT tide/trip-time task; measure what fraction stays local. Carried from 2026-07-26.

signals.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite: cheap, fast real-time inference
signals.summary: Flash-Lite at $0.30/M in, $2.50/M out, 350 tok/sec. Cheap enough for always-on agent loops. Carried from last run; now with Kimi-K3 open weights as an owned-land alternative.
signals.run_with_it_note: Brain behind a lightweight SMS/voice loop on his Twilio line. Carried from 2026-07-26.

signals.title: Screenpipe (YC S26): record how you work, turn it into agents
signals.summary: Local screen/audio recording that turns your own workflow into agents. Carried from last run; still a Watch.
